title: From gut to green energy: the essential role of anaerobic fungi in sustainable biofuel production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00240K, Review Article
Payal Deshpande, Prashant K. Dhakephalkar
Anaerobic fungi in herbivores efficiently degrade lignocellulosic biomass, presenting significant potential for sustainable biofuel production and environmental benefits.
